snippet.title: WHAT THE CLASH? | Same Screen OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
COUCH SEASON IS HERE!

Featuring something that has been maybe the #1 request by players: Same and Split Screen!

This trailer features the SAME SCREEN gameplay, available on iPhone/ iPad. Put the device between you, and play on the same screen! We’re hand-picked levels that we think work best for this format, and made a new quick-match system.

Story: There’s been some strange weather in Champion City and a new face has arrived in town- or should we say two faces..? Sofun & Cushy share one plush, comfy body, but their rivalry has sent ripples across the whole City: are you team BLUE or RED? 

Couch Season will run for a month, with unique events and cosmetics you can only grab in this time. BUT when the season is over - Sofun & Cushy will be here to stay! 

So get comfy, be a couch-potato and join in the fun!

#whattheclash #applearcade #trailer #gameupdate #samescreen #coop #playtogether
